blanket_clippy_restriction_lints: The command line intentionally enables the complete restriction group so additions in the pinned Clippy cannot be missed.
implicit_return: Requiring explicit return conflicts with Clippy's idiomatic needless-return lint.
question_mark_used: Forbidding the question-mark operator conflicts with Clippy's question-mark simplification lint.
self_named_module_files: The permanent module layout deliberately uses foo.rs with foo/ children instead of mod.rs.
semicolon_outside_block: This conflicts with semicolon-inside-block; the project selects inside-block placement.
separated_literal_suffix: This conflicts with unseparated-literal-suffix; the project selects separated suffixes.
pub_without_shorthand: This conflicts with pub-with-shorthand; the project selects shorthand visibility syntax.
